package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"github.com/ProtoDurian/diene.go-interfaces/lib/interfaces"
	"github.com/ProtoDurian/diene.go-interfaces/testhelper"
)

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()
	modified := time.Now()
	entry := interfaces.NewVfsEntry("/a", interfaces.VfsEntryTypeFile, 1, &modified)
	var _ interfaces.VfsEntry = entry
	fmt.Println(interfaces.VfsEntryTypeFile.String(), interfaces.VfsEntryTypeDirectory, interfaces.VfsEntryTypeLink)
	fmt.Println(interfaces.LogLevelTrace.String(), interfaces.LogLevelDebug, interfaces.LogLevelInfo, interfaces.LogLevelWarning, interfaces.LogLevelError, interfaces.LogLevelFatal)
	fmt.Println(interfaces.MetricKindCounter.String(), interfaces.MetricKindGauge, interfaces.MetricKindHistogram)
	var _ interfaces.VfsWriteOptions = interfaces.WriteOptions{}
	var _ interfaces.VfsListOptions = interfaces.ListOptions{}
	var _ interfaces.VfsDirectoryOptions = interfaces.DirectoryOptions{}
	command := interfaces.NewTerminalCommand("echo", []string{"ok"}, nil, nil, true, false)
	var _ interfaces.TerminalCommand = command.Clone()
	fmt.Println((interfaces.TerminalOutput{}).Succeeded())
	log := interfaces.NewLogRecord(time.Now(), interfaces.LogLevelInfo, "message", nil, nil, nil)
	var _ interfaces.LogRecord = log.Clone()
	_ = interfaces.CloneAttributes(nil)
	metric := interfaces.NewMetricRecord(time.Now(), "count", interfaces.MetricKindCounter, 1, nil, nil)
	var _ interfaces.MetricRecord = metric.Clone()

	system := testhelper.NewInMemorySystem(testhelper.InMemorySystemOptions{})
	system.EnqueueEnvironmentResult(nil, nil)
	system.EnqueueDirectoryResult("/", nil)
	system.EnqueueClockResult(time.Now(), nil)
	system.EnqueueDelayResult(nil)
	var port interfaces.System = system
	_, _ = port.Environment("x")
	_, _ = port.CurrentDirectory()
	_, _ = port.NowUTC()
	_ = port.Delay(ctx, time.Second)
	_ = system.RequestedDelays()
	system.SetEnvironment("x", "y")
	system.SetDirectory("/")
	system.SetNow(time.Now())

	vfs := testhelper.NewInMemoryVfs(testhelper.InMemoryVfsOptions{})
	vfs.EnqueueExistsResult(false, nil)
	vfs.EnqueueReadBytesResult(nil, nil)
	vfs.EnqueueReadTextResult("", nil)
	vfs.EnqueueWriteBytesResult(nil)
	vfs.EnqueueWriteTextResult(nil)
	vfs.EnqueueListResult(nil, nil)
	vfs.EnqueueCreateDirectoryResult(nil)
	vfs.EnqueueDeleteResult(nil)
	var files interfaces.Vfs = vfs
	_, _ = files.Exists(ctx, "/")
	_, _ = files.ReadBytes(ctx, "/")
	_, _ = files.ReadText(ctx, "/")
	_ = files.WriteBytes(ctx, "/x", nil, interfaces.WriteOptions{})
	_ = files.WriteText(ctx, "/x", "", interfaces.WriteOptions{})
	_, _ = files.List(ctx, "/", interfaces.ListOptions{})
	_ = files.CreateDirectory(ctx, "/x", interfaces.DirectoryOptions{})
	_ = files.Delete(ctx, "/x", interfaces.DirectoryOptions{})
	_ = vfs.Files()
	_ = vfs.Directories()

	terminal := testhelper.NewInMemoryTerminal()
	terminal.EnqueueResult(interfaces.TerminalOutput{}, nil)
	var runner interfaces.Terminal = terminal
	_, _ = runner.Run(ctx, command)
	_ = terminal.Commands()
	logger := testhelper.NewInMemoryLoggerSink()
	logger.EnqueueResult(nil)
	var sink interfaces.LoggerSink = logger
	_ = sink.Emit(log)
	_ = logger.Records()
	metrics := testhelper.NewInMemoryMetricsCollector()
	metrics.EnqueueResult(nil)
	var collector interfaces.MetricsCollector = metrics
	_ = collector.Emit(metric)
	_ = metrics.Records()
}
